en.quote: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
en.riddle: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols
en.speaker: the Lord GOD

he.quote: לָכֵן אֱמֹר אֶל-בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה שׁוּבוּ וְהָשִׁיבוּ, מֵעַל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וּמֵעַל כָּל-תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיכֶם הָשִׁיבוּ פְנֵיכֶֽם
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה

en.quote: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
en.riddle: I will stretch out My hand upon him
en.speaker: I the LORD

he.quote: וְהַנָּבִיא כִֽי-יְפֻתֶּה וְדִבֶּר דָּבָר אֲנִי יְהוָה פִּתֵּיתִי אֵת הַנָּבִיא הַהוּא וְנָטִיתִי אֶת-יָדִי, עָלָיו וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּיו מִתּוֹךְ עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
he.speaker: אֲנִי אֲדֹנָי
